name: frozen_forecast_warning_calibration
primary_endpoint: macro event F1 over seven datasets after averaging seeds
selection: One shared family selected by mean validation-second-half q95 F1 over both models, all datasets and seeds. Per-case coefficients fit on validation-first-half only; thresholds use validation-second-half only. Test evaluation begins only after selection.json is frozen.
validation_split: chronological halves, first-half fitting targets contained before midpoint, second-half threshold selection; five-step target boundary purge
event_protocol: Existing first-issue alarm-episode one-to-one greedy matching within five minutes; current reading must be at or below the fixed training-only node threshold. Onsets require all five prior prediction opportunities.
test_scope: Reassessment on the previously examined chronological test split; no test labels used to select calibration family, parameters, or operating point. Not a newly collected blind external test.
history_reference: fixed logistic history-only detector, identical fitting and threshold selection; reported separately
secondary_forecast_endpoints: five-step MAE/RMSE when current stress is within0.5 training-node SD below q95 threshold
empty_event_selection_fallback: If the threshold-selection half has no observed onsets, the primary operating point preserves the original direct-threshold rule for both forecasters; no threshold is learned from absence of events. Budget operating points preserve the validation false-alarm constraint; the history-only reference retains its original selection rule. Added from validation-only data before any calibrated test evaluation.
